lessons.claim: hoomd.update.BoxResize affinely scales the particle coordinates (a measured error of 8.9e-16) -- so compression also shrinks the bond length of pairs that are already bonded. When the well is narrow, as with a DLVO secondary minimum, the moment the linear strain per trigger exceeds (h_min−h_barrier)/ℓ the pair is pushed inside the barrier and **collapses irreversibly** into the primary minimum (contact). There is no error; only the bond type quietly changes. Measured: the predicted threshold is 0.703%, ε=0.40% per trigger keeps h*=0.007591, and 0.80% collapses to h*=−0.042257 (a 4.2% overlap). Compute ε_crit from the ledger before compressing and set the number of stages from it.
